answersA.title: Kubernetes rolling updates
answersA.text: Kubernetes handles rolling updates by gradually replacing old pods with new ones. It ensures that new pods are ready and healthy before terminating the old ones, minimizing downtime. This process can be configured with parameters like `maxUnavailable` and `maxSurge` to control the pace of the update and the desired availability.

answersA.title: How Kubernetes handles rolling updates

This ensures that your application remains available throughout the update process, with zero downtime.

It allows you to define a mapping between different URL paths and the components that should be displayed for those paths. You configure this mapping in an array of route objects, specifying the path and the component.
